docs.title: The Two-Bucket Finance Model
docs.text: Most financial advice overcomplicates things. FinVer is built around a simple, battle-tested framework: Two Buckets, One Tap.

docs.title: The Infinity Loop: How Buckets Connect & Complement
docs.text:
%%{init: {'flowchart': {'nodeSpacing': 60, 'rankSpacing': 90, 'padding': 30, 'curve': 'basis'}, 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '16px'}}}%%
flowchart TB
    INCOME["💰 Income\nSalary • Business • Rent • Dividends"]
    TAP["🚰 The Tap — Allocation\n30–50% → Assets Bucket\n50–70% → Cash Flow Bucket"]

    ASSETS["🪣 Assets Bucket\n(Never Sell)\nEquity • PPF • Land • Gold"]
    CASHFLOW["🪣 Cash Flow Bucket\n(Spend Freely)\nG-Sec • FD • Dividends • Annuity"]
    CYCLE["♾️ The Loop\nCash Flow funds life →\nprotects Assets → Assets compound\n→ rare surplus reinforces Cash Flow"]

    INCOME --> TAP
    TAP -->|30–50%| ASSETS
    TAP -->|50–70%| CASHFLOW
    CASHFLOW ==>|Yield funds life| CYCLE
    CYCLE ==>|Protects principal| ASSETS
    ASSETS -.->|Rare surplus| CASHFLOW

    classDef bucket fill:#0f172a,stroke:#38bdf8,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc,font-size:16px,font-weight:bold;
    classDef tap fill:#3a1000,stroke:#fb923c,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff7ed,font-size:16px,font-weight:bold;

    class TAP tap

Read the loop clockwise: Income → Tap allocates → Bucket 1 compounds (never touched) → Bucket 2 yields cash flow → funds life → protects Bucket 1 → cycle continues. Rare surplus from Bucket 1 overflow reinforces Bucket 2.

docs.title: 🪣 Bucket 1 — The Growth Bucket (Never Touch, Never Sell)
docs.text:
Purpose: Build generational wealth. Compound uninterrupted. Principal never liquidated.

Asset Role Why It Belongs Here Quality Equity Stocks Capital growth Compounders you never sell — hold for decades PPF Tax-free backbone 15-year lock-in, sovereign guarantee, tax-free corpus Land Real asset hedge Scarcity value, generational transfer, inflation proof Gold Crisis insurance Rupee depreciation hedge, portfolio stabilizer

Rules: - ❌ No selling equity "because it went up" - ❌ No breaking PPF before maturity - ❌ No monetizing land/gold for lifestyle - ✅ Only add. Rebalance by adding new money.

Why it works: Compounding needs uninterrupted time and principal. Every sale/reset destroys the exponential curve.

docs.title: 🪣 Bucket 2 — The Income Bucket (Cash Flow for Life)
docs.text:
Purpose: Generate reliable cash flow. Fund daily life. Protect Bucket 1 from ever being touched.

Asset Yield Source Role G-Sec / SDL / T-Bills Sovereign coupon Risk-free baseline income FD (Interest Payout) Bank interest Predictable monthly/quarterly cash High Dividend Stocks Dividend yield Growing income + inflation hedge Annuity / Pension Plans Guaranteed payout Longevity insurance, fixed floor

Rules: - ✅ Spend the interest/coupon/dividend/anxiety-free - ✅ Principal stays — only yield flows out - ✅ Replenish from Bucket 1 overflow only (rare) - ❌ Never dip into Bucket 1 principal

docs.title: 🚰 The Tap — Income Allocation
docs.text:
Every rupee that hits your account flows through The Tap:

Income (Salary, Business, Rent, Dividends)
  │
  ├─► Bucket 1 (Growth)  ──► "Buy assets you never sell"
  │      │
  │      ├─ Quality Stocks (SIP/lumpsum)
  │      ├─ PPF (max ₹1.5L/yr)
  │      ├─ Land (when opportunity arises)
  │      └─ Gold (5-10% allocation)
  │
  └─► Bucket 2 (Income)  ──► "Build the cash flow machine"
       │
       ├─ G-Sec Ladder (1-10yr, roll over)
       ├─ FD Ladder (monthly/quarterly payout)
       ├─ Dividend Aristocrats Portfolio
       └─ Annuity (post-60 or earlier)

The discipline: Bucket 1 allocation happens first — automated. Bucket 2 builds the moat that lets Bucket 1 compound undisturbed.

docs.title: Philosophy
docs.text: Wealth isn't built by trading. It's built by owning assets you never sell, and building a system that lets you never sell them.
